result.description:
VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced Office Manager to join our clients' business Melbourne Collision Repair Centre Mentone in Mentone. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.

Position Summary:

The role of Office Manager is responsible for the full operation of office management activities at our company.
The incumbent in the role is expected to operate at a consistently high standard ensuring core administrative systems and relevant personnel are operating effectively and efficiently to adequately meet the needs of our growing business.

Scope of the role:

The scope of this role is broad, encompassing the full scope of activities required to support the smooth running of our office environment.

Main Duties:

- Coordinate and oversee administrative processes relating to tour bookings, accommodation reservations, customer enquiries and day-to-day office operations to ensure efficient service delivery.
- Develop, implement and review office procedures, administrative systems and service standards to support business growth and operational efficiency.
- Allocate administrative resources, office facilities and support staff to meet the operational requirements of the business.
- Supervise and assign work tasks, monitor performance and provide training and guidance to ensure business objectives are achieved.
- Maintain and manage customer records, booking systems, financial documentation, correspondence and other business administration records.
- Liaise with customers, suppliers, accommodation providers, contractors and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth business operations and resolve administrative matters.
- Oversee office budgets, process invoices, monitor expenditure and maintain accurate financial and administrative records for management reporting purposes.
- Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, company policies, tourism industry obligations and relevant legislative and regulatory requirements; while coordinating recruitment, onboarding, payroll administration and staff record management activities.

Hours of work:

This is a full-time role where the employee will be expected to work at least 38 hours per week.

Skill Required:

- Previous experience in similar roles
- Strong communication and time management skills
- Ability to prioritize, set goals, and a determination to achieve them
- Strong verbal and written skills
- Work well under pressure and with a team

Remuneration: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 + Super

Location: 39 Swanston Street, Mentone VIC 3194

If you are interested and think you will be a good fit for this role, please apply.

result.description:
About Us

Established in 1946, Teys Australia is a beef processing and food production business. We are best known for providing quality Aussie beef to customers here in Australia and around the world. 

With operations across 14 locations in Qld, NSW, Victoria, and South Australia, we are the second largest beef processor and exporter in Australia, employing over 5000 passionate people who drive our success, and bring their very best to work every day. 

Together, we focus on feeding people and enriching lives. Join us!

About the Role

Teys Australia is seeking qualified Maintenance Electricians to join the Asset Management team based at our Wagga Wagga processing site in New South Wales.The successful applicant will be responsible for maintaining the Wagga processing facility and equipment, and supporting the day-to-day production requirements of the business. #meatjobs

Role requirements include

Fault finding intricate meat processing machines
Carry out planned, preventative and reactive maintenance
Assist in the identification and elimination of bottle necks
Respond efficiently to breakdown conditions to minimise equipment/production downtime
Teys Australia offers a generous salary, employment stability, a lifestyle roster with career advancement opportunities and more!

About You

It is essential you have the following skills:

Electrical trade qualification
Knowledge of Instrumentation
Excellent communications and technical skills
Ability to develop circuit drawings and read circuit drawings
Fault finding experience with VSDs & PLCs
Switchboard building experience (essential)
PLC and HMI programming experience (essential)
Fire systems experience (desirable)
Current drivers licence.
Pass medical assessment including drug/alcohol testing
Willing to work rotating shifts including nights, weekends and public holidays

What’s in it for You

Attractive hourly rate starting from $50.23
Access to a variety of discounts: meat products, health insurance and retailers
Service recognition awards 
Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counselling services for you and your family
Opportunities to upskill and advance your career in meat production, maintenance, or management roles.
To Apply

If you are looking for an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment within a growing business offering excellent career development and opportunities, we encourage you to APPLY today. 

For a confidential discussion about this role, please phone Geoff on 0269383007. 

You can check us out at www.teysgroup.com.au or join us on https://www.facebook.com/TeysAustralia. 

Teys Video link:  https://www.youtube.com/embed/mFTL6wPXiQw

result.description:
Chef - Chan Kun Kee Hong Kong Restaurant (Rhodes, NSW)
Are you a talented and passionate Chef with a flair for creating exquisite dishes? Do you thrive in a dynamic culinary environment and have a keen eye for detail? Look no further! Chan Kun Kee Hong Kong Restaurant is seeking a skilled and dedicated Chef to join our team and contribute to the success of our authentic Hong Kong cuisine establishment.

About Us:
Chan Kun Kee is a renowned and authentic Hong Kong restaurant located in the vibrant suburb of Rhodes. With a focus on delivering exceptional culinary experiences and impeccable service, we have established ourselves as a go-to destination for Hong Kong cuisine. We take pride in our traditional recipes, using the finest ingredients to create memorable dining moments for our valued customers.

Responsibilities:

Plan menus, estimate food and labor costs, and order food supplies to ensure efficient kitchen operations.
Monitor the quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation, ensuring they meet our high standards.
Prepare more than 20 different sauces for various dishes, showcasing your expertise in Hong Kong cuisine.
Manage all kitchen staff, including training and leading them effectively to maintain a productive and harmonious team environment.
Discuss food preparation issues with managers, kitchen staff, and waiting staff to ensure smooth service and customer satisfaction.
Demonstrate techniques and advise on cooking procedures to enhance the skills of the kitchen team.
Prepare and cook fine cuisine, ensuring exquisite taste and presentation that reflects the authentic flavors of Hong Kong.
Explain and enforce hygiene regulations to maintain a clean and safe kitchen environment, upholding the highest standards of food safety.
Requirements:

Proven experience as a Chef, preferably specializing in Hong Kong cuisine.
Strong knowledge of various cooking techniques and the ability to prepare a wide range of sauces for authentic dishes.
Excellent leadership and communication skills to effectively manage and inspire kitchen staff.
Attention to detail and a passion for maintaining high-quality standards in taste, presentation, and overall dining experience.
Ability to plan menus, estimate costs, and order food supplies to optimize kitchen operations.
Understanding of hygiene regulations and the ability to enforce them to ensure a clean and safe kitchen environment.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and work well under pressure in a fast-paced culinary setting.
Speak fluent Cantonese and read Chinese.
In-depth knowledge of Hong Kong cuisine and dining trends.
Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $90,000.00 – $110,000.00 per year

Experience:

Kitchen: 2 years (Required)
Work Authorisation:

Australia (Preferred)
Work Location: In person
